name: store_two_longs_in_record

name: decrement_countdown_and_call
description: Decrements a 16-bit countdown held in the record and, when it reaches zero and a flag bit in the record is set, calls another library routine and returns its result. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/math.library:0:00F4
name: run_callbacks_or_set_pending
description: When the countdown field in the record is zero, it reads a value from the record and invokes two library function pointers, returning that value. When the countdown is nonzero, it sets a pending flag bit in the record and returns zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/math.library:0:010E
name: remove_node_and_free_memory
description: Reads the value at offset 36 of the record, then calls the Amiga exec library functions FreeMem and Remove, which unlink the node from its list and release its memory. It returns the saved value.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/math.library:0:013A
name: lookup_table_word_by_index
description: Returns the 16-bit word from a library data table at an index formed by the low nine bits of the input value, doubled to a byte offset. It is a plain indexed table read.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/math.library:0:015A
name: scale_offset_point_in_place
description: Rescales the x and y values in the record by a factor taken from the fifth field, divided by the sum of the third and fourth fields. It then adds the sixth and seventh fields as offsets, writing the results back in place.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/math.library:0:01A8
name: swap_word_halves_store
description: Swaps the upper and lower 16-bit halves of the data register value and stores the result at the address held in the second address register.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/math.library:0:01B4
name: scale_point_with_zero_guard
description: Scales the x and y values in the record by factors from the third and fourth fields, dividing each by a per-axis sum and skipping the division when that sum is zero. It then adds the fifth and sixth fields as offsets.

name: split_value_into_hundreds_pair
description: Calls another library routine with a fixed argument of minus one, then packs its returned value as a quotient and remainder by one hundred, the quotient in the upper half and the remainder in the lower half.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/math.library:0:044E
name: advance_linear_congruential_state
description: Optionally loads a 16-bit value into a library global when its argument is non-negative, then advances that global with a multiply-and-add step using fixed constants.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/math.library:0:0474
name: build_rotation_matrix_from_angles
description: Builds a 3x3 rotation-style matrix in fixed-point form from three angle values, using sine and cosine lookups from the library table. The nine 16-bit results are written to the record passed in.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/math.library:0:05C4
name: build_rotation_matrix_alternate_order
description: Builds a nine-element fixed-point matrix from three table-driven angle values, but multiplies the factors in a different order and sign pattern from its neighbour. The results are written to the record passed in.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/math.library:0:0716
name: stub_register_passthrough
description: Its decoded body does no work and only returns whatever values happen to be in the data registers. It is a placeholder with no real behaviour.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/math.library:0:07B2
name: multiply_fixed_point_matrices
description: Multiplies two 3x3 matrices of 16-bit fixed-point values and stores the result as nine 16-bit values in the output record. Each product sum is shifted right by 14 bits to renormalise it.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/math.library:0:080C
name: integer_square_root_bisection
description: Computes the integer square root of its 32-bit input by bisecting over 16-bit candidates and keeps the largest candidate whose square does not exceed the input. Inputs from one to three return one directly, and zero returns zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/math.library:0:0838
name: refine_square_root_bounds
description: Continues an integer square-root bisection, narrowing a pair of 16-bit bounds until they are adjacent, and returns the lower bound in the low word.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/math.library:0:084C
name: return_constant_one
description: Returns a fixed value of one in the high word, passing the other argument through unchanged. It is a trivial helper with no further computation.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/math.library:0:0856
name: interpolate_inverse_table_lookup
description: Takes the absolute value of its input and binary-searches a sorted 16-bit table for it, then linearly interpolates between the two neighbouring entries to give a fractional index. The sign of the original input is applied to the result.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/math.library:0:088E
name: bisect_table_and_interpolate
description: Binary-searches a sorted 16-bit table, passed by address, for the input value and interpolates between the bracketing entries. The result is negated when the sign argument is negative.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/math.library:0:0892
name: interpolate_between_table_entries
description: Computes the fractional position of the input value between two table entries using a 16-bit fixed-point division. The result is negated when the sign argument is negative.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/math.library:0:08C4
name: compute_clamped_face_normal_dot
description: Forms difference vectors from three points, takes their cross product and dots it with a fourth vector, then scales the result by values stored in the record. The final value is clamped to a maximum taken from the record.

name: return_constant_minus_one
description: Returns a constant of minus one as a 32-bit result. The body has no other work.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:011E
name: open_math_library_once
description: Increments a usage count and, on first use, opens the math.library shared library through the exec library call and stores its base for later use. On later calls it returns the stored base.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0152
name: close_library_on_last_use
description: Decrements the usage count and, when the last user releases the library, clears the stored base and calls the exec CloseLibrary function.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0198
name: allocate_and_init_entry_buffer
description: Allocates a record sized from an entry count in its input, plus a fixed header, then sets its size, stride and pointer fields for either a plain or an extended parameter layout. It returns the new record.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:01E0
name: allocmem_and_init_entry_buffer
description: Allocates a record through the exec AllocMem call and fills in the same size, stride and pointer fields from the parameter block, depending on a flag in that block. If allocation fails, it calls a fallback routine instead.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:023E
name: reinit_entry_buffer_fields
description: Recomputes the entry count, stride and pointer fields of an existing record from a size value in the parameter block, without allocating anything.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0286
name: call_then_return_argument
description: Calls another library routine for its side effect, then returns the value that was passed in as its argument.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0292
name: clear_pending_and_call_library
description: If a pending-state field in the record is set, it clears that field and calls a library function with a small code, then makes a second library call selected by a flag bit. It then calls a further routine before returning.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:02B8
name: free_memory_via_exec_sequence
description: Makes exec library calls in a fixed sequence, choosing between two call forms by a flag bit, and then calls another routine. The referenced exec functions include FreeMem, so this path releases memory before returning.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:02DA
name: free_memory_then_call_next
description: Calls the exec memory-release function (FreeMem) through the library base, then calls another routine and returns. It is a short release-and-continue step.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:02EC
name: allocate_entry_buffer_by_count
description: Allocates a record sized from the entry count in the low word of its input at 84 bytes per entry, then sets its size, stride and pointer fields. It returns the record, or the fallback value when allocation fails.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:031C
name: allocate_entry_buffer_from_size
description: Allocates a record through the exec AllocMem call and sets its size, stride and pointer fields from the size argument. It returns the record, or the fallback argument when allocation fails.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0368
name: return_passed_argument
description: Returns the value passed on the stack without changing it. It does no other work.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0370
name: reset_record_bounds_sentinels
description: Resets a record's position fields to zero and sets its four bound fields to the largest and smallest 16-bit values, so that later updates shrink or grow them to the real extent.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:039E
name: transform_point_list_with_divide
description: Walks a list of points, adds each point to the record's offset vector and stores the translated point back. It then projects the x and y values by dividing by depth-like sums taken from the record, skipping a division whose divisor is zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:041A
name: compute_weighted_component_sum
description: Multiplies three input components by three record fields, skipping any zero component, and sums the products. The total is repacked into a fixed-point word pair and returned.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0492
name: scale_point_with_zero_guard
description: Scales the x and y values in the record by factors from the third and fourth fields, dividing each by a per-axis sum and skipping the division when that sum is zero. It then adds the fifth and sixth fields as offsets.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:04D0
name: copy_record_state_and_flags
description: Copies a fixed block of fields from the source record into the destination record, then returns a result word built from the source flag bits. When a particular flag bit is set, it also copies a saved block of fields.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:053C
name: copy_saved_fields_when_flagged
description: If the bit-two flag is set in the source record, it returns that bit at once. Otherwise, when the low flag bits are set, it copies five saved fields into the destination and returns the bit-four value; if neither applies it returns zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:056A
name: copy_saved_fields_on_flag
description: When either of the two low flag bits is set in the source record, it copies five saved fields into the destination and returns the bit-four value. Otherwise it returns zero.

description: Stores three 16-bit parts of its two arguments into fixed fields of the record, writing the low and high words of the first argument and the low word of the second. It returns nothing.

description: Walks a linked list of nodes and, for nodes with the expected flag bits set, moves a byte field toward a target by a proportional step derived from a range in the record divided by a span. The update is skipped when the span is zero.

description: Walks a linked list of nodes and, for each node that passes a test, widens the record's four bound fields to include that node's extents. Passing nodes are also linked back to the record's list head.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/tridee.library:0:0744
name: extend_bounds_and_relink_nodes
description: Walks a linked list of nodes, clearing each link as it goes, and widens the record's four bound fields to include each node that passes the test. Passing nodes are relinked into a new list.

description: Computes a byte field from a projection term subtracted from a record value, clamps negative results to zero, and writes the sum into the record. It is skipped unless the flags allow it, and one flag path uses an alternate source value.

name: update_byte_field_when_flagged
description: When a flag bit in the library state is set, it computes a clamped projection-derived byte and stores it in the record. Otherwise it returns without change.

description: Calls one library routine, then calls a second one only when a condition flag is set, and returns one in either case.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0576
name: call_conditional_helper_then_one
description: Calls one library routine and then a second one only when the condition flag is set, returning the constant one.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0584
name: call_helper_flag_return_result
description: Calls one library routine and returns its result, unless a condition flag is set, in which case it calls a second routine and returns one.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0592
name: copy_entry_values_to_array
description: When a pending field in the record is negative, it copies a count of 32-bit values from the record's entries into the output array, choosing between two address layouts by a flag bit.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:05BC
name: copy_pointed_values_to_array
description: Copies a count of 32-bit values from a table of record pointers into the output array, reading each entry at a fixed offset within the record it points to.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:05C8
name: write_clipped_point_bitplanes
description: Waits for the blitter, then for each point inside the record's clip rectangle sets or clears a single bit in each bitplane, using a mask derived from the point and the record's source data. It returns one.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:05D6
name: write_clipped_point_bits_direct
description: Performs the same clipped per-point bit write across the bitplanes without first waiting for the blitter, and returns one.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0630
name: write_clipped_bit_runs
description: Writes a run of bits into each bitplane at successive positions taken from a list, skipping points outside the clip rectangle. It returns one when the list ends.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:066A
name: rasterize_edge_span_endpoints
description: Steps an integer edge walk between the record's endpoints and, for each step inside the clip rectangle, stores clipped span endpoints into a table. Out-of-range steps store sentinel values, and the decompiled listing is truncated before the end.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0678
name: rasterize_edge_endpoints_flagged
description: Performs the same edge walk as its neighbour, first storing an input flag word in the record and then recording clipped span endpoints. The decompiled listing is truncated, so the closing steps are not described.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:06A4
name: rasterize_edge_endpoints_full
description: Steps a line-style edge walk over the record's endpoints, recording clipped span endpoints into the table and using sentinels for out-of-range rows. The walk is the longest of this group and its listing is truncated before the end.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:07EA
name: step_edge_span_pair_endpoints
description: Steps a Bresenham-style edge walk between two endpoints and stores clipped left and right span endpoints at each step, using sentinels for rows outside the clip rectangle. The decompiled listing is truncated, so the closing steps are not described.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0844
name: step_edge_span_pair_swapped
description: Steps the same edge walk with the axes swapped, storing clipped endpoints for each stepped row and returning one when the walk completes. The listing is truncated before the end.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:08AE
name: step_span_pair_alt_order
description: Runs the edge walk again with the endpoint-recording order changed, storing clipped endpoints and sentinels, and returns a value depending on the clip test at the end. The listing is truncated.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:08F0
name: step_span_pair_branch_a
description: Steps an edge walk between two endpoints using one decision-variable branch and stores clipped span endpoints for each row, with sentinels outside the clip rectangle. It returns one when the walk completes; the listing is truncated.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:08FE
name: step_span_pair_branch_b
description: Runs the same edge walk with a different decision ordering, storing clipped span endpoints per row and returning zero or one from the clip test. The listing is truncated.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:091E
name: step_span_pair_branch_c
description: Runs the edge walk with another decision ordering, storing clipped span endpoints and sentinels per row until the walk completes. The listing is truncated.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:092C
name: check_span_range_and_return
description: When a flag word in the library state is set, it tests a span range against the clip limits, returning zero if the span lies outside them and otherwise calling a further routine. It returns one at the end.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0968
name: return_zero_value
description: Returns zero. The body has no other work.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0972
name: return_minus_one_when_negative
description: Returns minus one only when two negative flag words in the library state and record are both set, and returns zero otherwise.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0986
name: clamp_record_bounds_to_clip
description: Clamps the record's four bound fields against the clip limits and stores the results in the library state, so later stages work with the clipped box.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:09D0
name: clip_polygon_against_rectangle
description: Clips a polygon's vertex list against the horizontal and vertical bounds in turn, interpolating new vertices where edges cross and writing the survivors into the output buffer. It returns minus one when the polygon is rejected and zero otherwise.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0A70
name: clip_vertex_list_against_edge
description: Clips a list of vertex values against one boundary, interpolating a crossing vertex where an edge crosses it, and writes the resulting list to the output buffer. It returns the last value written, or a combined pair when output remains.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0AF2
name: clip_vertex_list_against_bound
description: Clips a vertex list against a single bound, interpolating crossing vertices and writing the survivors to the output buffer. It returns minus one when vertices were kept and the last value otherwise.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0B42
name: return_zero_value
description: Returns zero. The body has no other work.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0B46
name: clip_vertices_into_rectangle_bounds
description: Copies the record's vertex data into the clip buffer when the bound test passes, then clips the vertex list against the rectangle's edges, interpolating crossing points. The decompiled listing is truncated, and it returns zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0BBE
name: copy_and_clip_vertex_pairs
description: Copies pairs of 32-bit vertex values from a table of record pointers into a buffer and clips them against the bounds. It returns minus one when the box is rejected, and the last value otherwise.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0C32
name: clip_vertex_pairs_against_bound
description: Clips a vertex list against a bound, writing the surviving and crossing vertices to the output buffer and storing a flag word in the record. It returns minus one or the last value, depending on whether vertices were kept.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0CBA
name: clip_vertex_list_lower_bound
description: Clips a vertex list against a lower bound taken from the record, interpolating crossing vertices and writing survivors to the output buffer. It returns minus one when vertices were kept, otherwise the last value.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0D0A
name: store_word_return_zero
description: Stores its 16-bit argument into a field of the record and returns zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0D12
name: fill_edge_span_table_values
description: Walks a list of vertex pairs, tracks the overall minimum and maximum of their x values, and fills a per-row table with values interpolated along each edge. It returns the minimum and maximum as a packed pair.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0D6C
name: interpolate_span_table_rows
description: Walks vertex pairs and fills the per-row table with values interpolated along each span, tracking the running minimum and maximum. It returns the minimum and maximum as a packed pair.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0DA2
name: build_span_rows_from_edges
description: Walks edge pairs in the record and, when a visibility flag passes, computes interpolated values for each row and writes packed span words to the output buffer. Otherwise it fills a per-row table of interpolated values; the decompiled listing is partly unstructured.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0E10
name: fill_interpolated_row_table
description: Walks vertex pairs and fills a per-row table with values interpolated along each edge, storing a final row value after each span. It returns nothing.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0E32
name: fill_interpolated_rows_wait_blitter
description: Waits for the blitter, then fills per-row tables with values interpolated along each edge pair, writing a final row value after each span. It returns nothing.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0E56
name: program_blitter_for_edge_spans
description: Waits for the blitter, sets its mask and modulo registers, then for each edge pair computes step parameters and programs the blitter for each span. The decompiled listing is truncated before the closing loop.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0EC8
name: program_blitter_edge_rows
description: Waits for the blitter and loops over edge pairs, programming the blitter modulo registers and writing a span start word for each row of each edge.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0F24
name: start_blitter_row_operations
description: Waits for the blitter, then for each row of an edge pair writes the source and data words and starts a blit sized to that row, looping until the edge list ends.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0F60
name: draw_masked_span_rows
description: Draws horizontal spans into the bitplane buffer for each edge row, applying start and end masks from lookup tables and filling whole words between them. The decompiled listing is truncated before the end.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0F68
name: draw_masked_span_rows_alt
description: Draws masked horizontal spans like its neighbour, taking its row source from a different record field. The decompiled listing is truncated.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0F70
name: draw_masked_span_rows_blitter
description: Waits for the blitter, then draws masked horizontal spans for each edge row into the bitplane buffer, using start and end masks and filling the words between them. The listing is truncated.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:0FB6
name: draw_masked_span_rows_wide
description: Draws masked horizontal spans for each edge row into the bitplane buffer, choosing between two fill paths by a flag and using start and end masks from lookup tables. The decompiled listing is truncated before the end.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1040
name: draw_masked_spans_from_tables
description: Writes masked span words for each row from precomputed mask pairs into the bitplane buffer, advancing through the row pointer tables until the row count is exhausted.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1072
name: draw_masked_spans_pointer_rows
description: Walks edge rows and writes masked span words into the bitplane buffer using row pointer tables and two masks, updating the table pointers at the end of each row.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:10E6
name: write_masked_span_words
description: Writes masked span words into the bitplane buffer for each row of an edge list, combining start and end masks with the row pointer table. It advances the row pointers and returns nothing.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1122
name: draw_masked_span_rows_flagged
description: Draws masked horizontal spans for each edge row into the bitplane buffer, using one fill path when a flag byte is set and another otherwise, with masks from lookup tables.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1140
name: draw_masked_span_rows_paired
description: Draws masked spans per edge row into the bitplane buffer, with a flag choosing between paired-row fills and a single-row fill. It runs over the row count and returns nothing.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:118E
name: draw_masked_span_rows_stepped
description: Draws masked span rows from the edge list using a width-dependent fill of single, paired or run words, with mask pairs from lookup tables. It advances the row pointers until the list ends.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:11DA
name: fill_masked_rows_by_width
description: Fills masked span rows into the bitplane buffer, choosing a single-word or run fill from the span width, and advances through the edge list until it ends.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:11FE
name: fill_masked_span_rows_runs
description: Fills masked span rows with a run of identical words between the start and end masks, choosing single or multi-word paths from the span width.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1244
name: fill_masked_span_rows_blocks
description: Fills masked span rows into the bitplane buffer from the edge list, using start and end masks and filling the words between them, and advances the row table pointers until the list ends.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:12CA
name: fill_masked_span_rows_single
description: Fills a masked span row with a single mask pair and a run of words, advancing through the edge list and row pointers until the list ends.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1306
name: blit_span_rows_with_masks
description: Waits for the blitter, programs its masks, offsets and size for the span rows, then blits each row using the pointer table. The decompiled listing is truncated, and the routine returns a count.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:13DC
name: program_blitter_span_rows
description: Waits for the blitter and programs its masks and span parameters from the edge list, writing per-row blitter values and then the final control words. The decompiled listing is truncated.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1434
name: setup_blitter_span_rows_loop
description: Programs the blitter for each span row of the edge list, waiting for the blitter between rows and writing row offsets and sizes. The listing is truncated before the closing stage.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:152C
name: blit_row_loop_with_flags
description: Writes per-row blitter source and destination words from the row table, waiting for the blitter between rows, and finishes by writing the blitter control words. The listing is truncated.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:15DC
name: write_blitter_row_table
description: Waits for the blitter and writes the row table words and blitter control values for each row, advancing the row offsets. It returns when the row count runs out.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1628
name: write_span_row_words
description: Writes row words and offsets from the table into the blitter registers for each span row, looping over the row count and returning when done.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:168E
name: compute_span_row_offset
description: Computes a byte offset for the current span row from the record's position and a row multiplier or lookup table, returning it packed with a column value.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:16AA
name: compute_span_start_offset
description: Computes the start offset of a span from its column and the record's row stride, returning it packed with a second value.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:16C0
name: check_table_byte_flag
description: Reads a byte from a library table at an index taken from a data register, then returns on either branch without changing state. It has no observable effect.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:16F0
name: stub_immediate_return
description: The decompiled body is only a return, so the routine does nothing when called. Its decoded span does not match a real body, so it is treated as a placeholder.
